questions.q: What did the Lord tell Jacob when Laban's countenance changed toward him?
choices: Stay and serve seven more years
Return unto the land of thy fathers, and I will be with thee
questions.explain: The command to go home came with the promise of the Most High's presence.

questions.q: What did Rachel steal from her father?
questions.explain: Yes, she was fine, but she was a thief (Proverbs 31:30).

questions.q: What does Laban's question 'Wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?' show?
choices: Laban was a priest of the Most High
Laban was an idolater, like his fathers beyond the flood
Laban worshipped the God of Abraham only
questions.explain: Terah and Nachor served other gods (Joshua 24:2); that is why Abram was told to leave his kindred.
